name: Tadehara Hitomi
source:
The heroine. Her parents passed away, so she lives with her grandmother.
Calm and kind of an airhead.
Right as she was set to debut as a voice actress for anime, she died from suicide. Her final words were a wish to fall in love normally with Ichika.
She is the only one who knows Ichika's secret.
